meta.head: ed9926db
meta.method: Every examples/**/*.json parsed; project scene references read from assets.scene.path (string or {path}), assets.audio/environment, sequence.scenes[].file and every string ending in a file extension (resolved relative to the file, then the repo root); scene->scene/rig/material references followed transitively. Grouping: one record per distinct scene; projects over the same scene file (lighting/camera/song variants), phase iterations and generator presets are variant_files of their parent. Status: generated-missing = a referenced scene file is gitignored and absent on a clean checkout; not-indexed = reviewable but absent from examples/index.json. Category by intended use: Live = made for real-time audio/MIDI play (index live:true / sonic.live); Offline = rendered video, showcase, look-dev, lab, benchmark.

counts.branch_only_note: astral-furnace, astral-forge-2, rootworks, biovalley-2d (wetland-of-veils is its descendant pass); biovalley-water is a variant of biovalley-macro, proto/sonic-garden has none
